Speaker: Gao
Content: My father, you had been caught by the God <color=#FFDC88>Shu</color>.
ChineseContent: 父亲，你被<color=#FFDC88>署神</color>抓走了。

Speaker: Gao
Content: My father, how can I find your trace?
ChineseContent: 父亲，我该去哪里寻找你的踪迹？

Speaker: Fox
ChineseContent: 你的父亲，是<color=#FFDC88>Egaole</color>，对吗？

Speaker: Fox
ChineseContent: 而你，就是<color=#FFDC88>高勒趣</color>。

Speaker: Gao
Content: Exactly. Dear fox, how do you know us?
ChineseContent: 是的。狐狸，你怎么会认识我们？

Speaker: Fox
Content: Gao, the damage you two have caused to nature was so much!
ChineseContent: 高勒趣，你们父子给自然造成了太多伤害！

Speaker: Fox
Content: You even violated the contract and captured the wild boar of the God Shu!
ChineseContent: 你们甚至违背约定，猎杀了署神的野猪！

Speaker: Gao
Content: Well...but I don't think Shu has the right to catch my father.
ChineseContent: 可是……我不觉得署有权抓走我的父亲。

Speaker: Fox
Content: Gao, your father is imprisoned on <color=#9876C5>the fifth hill</color>, and <color=#FFDC88>this</color> is the first one.
ChineseContent: 高勒趣，你父亲被关在<color=#9876C5>第五座山</color>上，而<color=#FFDC88>这里</color>才是第一座。

Speaker: Fox
Content: To <color=#6AADFF>reconcile</color> rather than continue to destroy nature, otherwise you will also fall into the same fate.
ChineseContent: 去<color=#6AADFF>和解</color>，别再破坏自然，否则你也会落得同样的下场。

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 它消失了……

Speaker: Gao
Content: My father often said that, the south slope is sunny, the north valley is shady.
ChineseContent: 父亲常说，南坡向阳，北谷背阴。

Speaker: Gao
Content: White belongs <color=#FFDC88>above</color>. Black belongs <color=#FFDC88>below</color>. I must remember that.
ChineseContent: 白的归于<color=#FFDC88>高处</color>，黑的归于<color=#FFDC88>低处</color>。这句话，我得记住。

Speaker: Gao
Content: The snakes are twisting with each other, I can't pass through this way…
ChineseContent: 两条蛇缠在一起，挡住了去路……

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 那个，能不能请你们……

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 啊，谢谢。

Speaker: Gao
Content: The path is still blocked by these boulders.
ChineseContent: 这些巨石……还是把路堵住了。

Speaker: Gao
Content: But those two are still staring at each other. They will not budge.
ChineseContent: 可他们俩还是紧盯着彼此，怎么也推不动。

Speaker: Gao
ChineseContent: 也许……狐狸说得对。

Speaker: Gao
Content: This sunny cave is higher up. A place for the white snake.
ChineseContent: 这个洞向阳，在高处。白蛇应该归到这里。

Speaker: Gao
Content: This shaded cave is lower down. A place for the black snake.
ChineseContent: 这个洞背阴，在低处。黑蛇应该归到这里。

Speaker: Gao
Content: So many rocks, I'm definitely reaching the peak.
ChineseContent: 石头越来越多，应该快到山顶了。

Speaker: Gao
Content: If only something could stand between them, so they could no longer see each other...
ChineseContent: 要是有什么东西能隔在中间，让他们看不见彼此就好了……
Note: 巨石前对话，接在 35 后；不要更改索引顺序

Speaker: Gao
Content: Those red stones... perhaps I could push one between them.
ChineseContent: 那些红色的石头……或许能推过去试试。
Note: 巨石前对话，接在 35 后；不要更改索引顺序

Speaker: Gao
Content: Then their caves. Father said: <color=#FFDC88>white above, black below</color>.
ChineseContent: 然后是他们各自的洞。父亲说过：<color=#FFDC88>白的在高处，黑的在低处</color>。
Note: 巨石前对话，接在 35 后；不要更改索引顺序
